summary: Anthropic's interpretability team shares preliminary internal research findings, including a new method (TWERA-ranked downstream feature connections) for distinguishing which model features causally drive behavior versus merely co-activate.

practices.reason: Describes a method for identifying which internal features are causally responsible for model outputs, useful for interpretability-based trust and debugging but presented as preliminary internal research.
practices.quote: We find that inspecting a feature’s TWERA-ranked downstream features adds context about the circuits it is part of and distinguishes similar-looking features.
